Experience

Technical Product Manager Intern

Bank Sinarmas · MW Account team

Core Payment, Middleware & API Banking Division · Feb 2026 – present

I own the requirements for middleware APIs: I find out what the business and channel teams need, define how each API should behave, and follow it through build, testing, and release.

What I do

  1. Gather the need. Meet the business and channel teams, clarify the use cases, and check which existing APIs and apps would be impacted by the change.
  2. Define the API. Write the Product Requirements Document: the system flow, a Given–When–Then scenario for each use case, and the response codes. Decide whether to reuse an existing API or build a new one.
  3. Work with engineers. Walk the team through each scenario, check the requirements against their technical design, and plan the sprint.
  4. Support testing. Answer QA's questions during SIT and UAT, and update the requirements when testing finds a gap.
  5. Release. Prepare the final document for Change Control Board approval and line up the release with the channel's release date.

Highlights

  • 16 Product Requirements Documents and pre-reads; 4 projects now deployed
  • Built the MW Account API map and mapped which internal apps call which APIs
  • PIC (person in charge) for several projects
  • Helped plan the team's Q4 2026 roadmap

Non-Individual Customer & Account Management

Lets branches serve company customers (PT, CV, Koperasi, Yayasan).

Details

My part: Co-wrote the API requirements with my PM lead, one Given–When–Then scenario per use case, reusing the individual-customer APIs wherever possible.

A middleware API service for each use case:

  • Find a company and check whether it is already a customer
  • Create the company's customer record (CIF), for Indonesian and foreign companies, with its pemilik and pengurus (BI Board) and beneficial owners
  • View and update the company's customer data
  • Open company accounts such as Tabungan Simas Bisnis, Giro Corporate, and Deposito Corporate
  • View every account the company holds
  • Block an account with a reason, and unblock it
Deployed

Cheque & Bilyet Giro Management

A new service for cheque and bilyet giro books at branches.

Details

My part: Owned the API requirements end to end, from the Branch Banking team's needs to sprint planning with engineers, including the error messages shown in the Branch Operation System.

A middleware API service for each use case:

  • Stock new cheque and bilyet giro books at a branch
  • Issue a book to a customer's account
  • Block sheets that are damaged, lost, or stolen
  • Move stock that is registered at another branch
  • Report the books stocked at a branch and the status of each sheet
Deployed

Customer Inquiry Report

Search, list, and report individual customers at branches.

Details

My part: Wrote the API requirements to move this report from the older branch systems, with clear responses for invalid requests, no results, and timeouts, and checked them against the engineers' technical design.

A middleware API service for each use case:

  • Search individual customers by customer type, opening date, name, branch, or ID type
  • List the matching customers page by page, with partial and case-insensitive name search
Deployed

Duplicate Data Validation

Checks if a new customer's email, phone, or NIK is already in use.

Details

My part: Wrote the API requirements to rebuild the duplicate check from the older customer-service system as a middleware API, and updated them after a UAT finding.

A middleware API service for each use case:

  • Check whether an email or phone number is already used by another customer
  • Check whether a NIK is already used, and return the related customer records (CIF)
  • Limit either check to active customers when needed; blocked records are never returned

Beneficial Owner

Records who ultimately owns a customer's funds (POJK 8/2023).

Details

My part: Wrote the requirements for both APIs, following OJK regulation POJK 8/2023.

A middleware API service for each use case:

  • Update whether a customer acts for themselves or for a beneficial owner; the owner's details are required only when they apply, and removed from core banking when they no longer do
  • View a customer's beneficial owner details

Standing Order

Shows a customer's scheduled automatic transfers.

Details

My part: Revised the API requirements to close the gaps between the first version and what the branch screens need.

One middleware API service for these use cases:

  • Look up the standing orders of an account, telling "account not found" apart from "no standing order"
  • List the standing orders of a branch for its report
  • Show one standing order with customer name, charge amount, notes, status, and a readable period (daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly)
More middleware projects 7 projects

  • Deposito Override

    Requirements for a middleware API service that overrides a deposito (time deposit) interest rate, now or from the next renewal, with checks and safe retries so an override is never applied twice. Written for the MW Funding team.

    Deployed

  • Pocket

    Requirements for the middleware API services behind savings pockets in SimobiPlus: open, close, and view a pocket by reusing existing account APIs, with clear data ownership between the app, middleware, and core banking.

  • Customer Referral System

    Requirements for middleware API services that return an account's end-of-day balance, new funds, and total spending, which the referral program uses to qualify referrals.

  • Medallion Sales

    Requirements for middleware API services that give the mutual fund platform the account and customer data it needs for Reksadana subscriptions, top-ups, and redemptions.

  • Religion Update

    Requirements to extend the customer update middleware API service so religion can be changed after the record is created, following a Bank Indonesia requirement.

  • Remark Phase 2

    Requirements for middleware API services that carry longer transfer notes on RTOL, SKN, RTGS, and remittance transfers. I found internet banking flows that skip the middleware and passed that part to the channel team.

  • Centralized Audit Trail

    Requirements for a central audit trail service shared by internal apps. I simplified the use cases and wrote the data glossary before handing it over.

Glossary

API
How one system asks another for data or an action.
Middleware MW
The layer between the apps and core banking.
Product Requirements Document
What a feature must do, written before it is built.
Given–When–Then
Given a situation, when something happens, then the expected result.
Branch Operation System
The app branch staff use to serve customers.
SimobiPlus
Bank Sinarmas's mobile banking app.
Core banking T24
The main system for customers, accounts, and balances.
CIF
Customer Information File, the record for each customer.
NIK
The Indonesian national ID number.
SIT and UAT
System and user acceptance testing, before release.
CCB
Change Control Board, which approves each release.
Deployed
Live in production.
